<js>
var d = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result || ""));
var as = d.select(".page .page_list a[href]");
var cur = 0, m = String(baseUrl || "").match(/\/page\/(\d+)/);
if (m) cur = parseInt(m[1], 10);
var u = "";
for (var i = 0; i < as.size(); i++) {
  var h = "" + as.get(i).attr("href"), mm = h.match(/\/page\/(\d+)/);
  if (mm && parseInt(mm[1], 10) > cur) {
    u = h;
    break;
  }
}
if (u && u.indexOf("http") !== 0) u = "http://www.ccg.org.cn" + u;
result = u;
</js>

<js>
var d = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result || "")), as = d.select("a[href]"), u = "";
for (var i = 0; i < as.size(); i++) {
  var a = as.get(i), t = "" + a.text();
  if ((/下一页|下页|next/i).test(t)) {
    u = "" + a.attr("href");
    break;
  }
}
if (u) {
  if (u.indexOf("http") !== 0) {
    var b = String(baseUrl || "");
    if (b.charAt(b.length - 1) !== "/") b = b.substring(0, b.lastIndexOf("/") + 1);
    if (u.indexOf("./") === 0) u = u.substring(2);
    u = b + u;
  }
}
result = u;
</js>

<js>
var d = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result || "")), as = d.select(".pager a[href]"), u = "";
for (var i = 0; i < as.size(); i++) {
  var a = as.get(i), t = String(a.text()).toLowerCase();
  if (t.indexOf("вперед") >= 0 || t.indexOf("next") >= 0) {
    u = String(a.attr("href"));
    break;
  }
}
if (u && u.indexOf("http") !== 0) u = "https://mid.ru" + u;
result = u;
</js>
